evidence_items.locator: Abstract, Safety Trial; full paper section VII-A
evidence_items.explanation: Meta's initial experiment found longer reviews; a second trial ending December 18, 2024 found no statistically significant regression after changing how suggested patches appeared. This challenges inevitability, but concerns targeted patches and an earlier workflow rather than the full March 2026 claim.

evidence_items.locator: Page 10, comparison of AI-generated and human-written code review; page 4, fieldwork dates
evidence_items.explanation: The survey reports greater review effort for 38% of developers and less effort for 27%. It supports review burdens for a substantial group while showing variation; self-reported effort does not establish review duration or the claimed causal mechanism.
